verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LM Studio documents a REST API and OpenAI-like endpoints, and its docs are available as llms.txt and markdown. Nothing shows an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. Having an API, or machine-readable docs, is not the same as an interactive explorer, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
